faq.title: Everything you need to know about us

items.q: Is Abdul Wahid Motors an authorized BYD dealer?
items.a: Yes. We are the authorized BYD dealer in Damascus, offering sales, service and genuine spare parts.

items.q: How do I reserve a car?
items.a: Pick a car on the cars page and reserve it with a deposit online, then follow the reservation until handover from your account.

items.q: Can I book a service appointment on the website?
items.a: Yes. Choose the service, branch, day and time, and our team will contact you to confirm.

items.q: How do I know the condition of my Blade battery?
items.a: We inspect Blade batteries and issue a digital certificate that anyone can verify through a link or the QR code printed on the report.

items.q: Which payment methods do you accept?
items.a: Bank transfer and mobile wallet payment, with a receipt upload so our team can confirm the payment.

contact.title: We'd love to hear from you
contact.text: Write to us, call us or follow us on our channels.

hero.title: Service for your car, to the manufacturer's standards
hero.text: From periodic service to Blade battery checks, our technicians look after your car at the Sahnaya and Kafr Sousa branches, and you follow the service history and invoices from your account.

battery.title: Digital battery inspection and a verifiable certificate
battery.text: We measure the condition of your Blade battery and record the results in a report you can open in your account, with a certificate anyone can verify through a link or QR code.
items: State of health (SOH) and state of charge (SOC)
